- main:
  - region "We film Houston.":
    - img "Two hands adjust a camera on a gimbal in a generated room."
    - button "Play the film"
    - status
    - heading "We film Houston." [level=1]
    - paragraph: Weekly content for Houston businesses — Reels, photos, and a posting schedule you actually keep.
    - link "Book a test shoot.":
      - /url: tel:+17138999346
    - link "Call 713-899-9346.":
      - /url: tel:+17138999346
    - term: Test Shoot
    - definition: $700 one time
    - term: Full Package
    - definition: $3,500 a month
    - paragraph: In a generated room, two hands adjust a camera on a gimbal. A calendar and an editing desk follow.
    - paragraph: "This film was made with AI: stills from Seedream v5 pro and motion from Seedance 2.0, through Higgsfield, on October 2, 2026. The room is generated. It is not a real Houston location, our studio or our crew."
  - region "Test Shoot":
    - heading "Test Shoot" [level=2]
    - paragraph: $700 one time
    - list:
      - listitem: One shoot, up to 2 hours
      - listitem: 2 edited Reels
      - listitem: 15–25 edited photos
      - listitem: Creative direction on set
      - listitem: Formatted for Instagram and TikTok, ready to post
  - region "Full Package":
    - heading "Full Package" [level=2]
    - paragraph: $3,500 a month
    - list:
      - listitem: 4–8 shoots per month, 2–3 hours each
      - listitem: 12–16+ edited Reels
      - listitem: 120–200 edited photos
      - listitem: Lifestyle, branding, product and team photography
      - listitem: Cinematic brand content
      - listitem: Full creative direction
      - listitem: Monthly content strategy and calendar
      - listitem: Hook and caption assistance
      - listitem: Trend research
      - listitem: Instagram and TikTok optimisation
      - listitem: Behind-the-scenes and story content
      - listitem: Monthly strategy meeting
      - listitem: Priority editing
      - listitem: Drone / aerial included where applicable
  - paragraph:
    - link "Pricing, with the add-ons":
      - /url: /pricing
  - paragraph: On the Full Package we come to your business four to eight times a month, shoot, edit, and hand you the posts with a calendar.
  - region "Your kind of work.":
    - heading "Your kind of work." [level=2]
    - term: Med spa
    - definition:
      - paragraph: The treatment menu changed and the page still shows last season.
      - paragraph: We come to the room. We film the staff, the device, and the work. You get the posts and the calendar.
    - term: Restaurant
    - definition:
      - paragraph: The special is gone and the photo of it is still up, shot in bad light.
      - paragraph: We film the dish and the room on a schedule, so the feed matches the menu.
    - term: Gym
    - definition:
      - paragraph: One member films, and the class looks empty.
      - paragraph: We film the week of classes in the room, with people who have said yes.
    - term: Auto
    - definition:
      - paragraph: The build is finished and the footage is still on a phone.
      - paragraph: We walk the car and cut the Reels.
    - term: Home services
    - definition:
      - paragraph: The before-and-after is the proof, and nobody shot it.
      - paragraph: We document the job from start to finish and turn it into the month.
    - term: Real estate team
    - definition:
      - paragraph: Every listing has photos. The team itself has no face.
      - paragraph: We film the team, on a week that is not a listing.
  - region "Already posting?":
    - heading "Already posting?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: You do. The gap is the weeks you don’t. We keep the cadence so it doesn’t depend on somebody remembering.
  - region "Book a test shoot. Two hours, two Reels, 15 to 25 photos, $700.":
    - heading "Book a test shoot. Two hours, two Reels, 15 to 25 photos, $700." [level=2]
    - link "Book a test shoot.":
      - /url: tel:+17138999346
    - link "Call 713-899-9346.":
      - /url: tel:+17138999346

- main "API access":
  - region "API keys":
    - text: Programmatic access
    - heading "API keys" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Scoped keys authorize REST, MCP, and CLI automation. Keys cannot bypass quote confirmation or spend autonomously. Revocation is immediate.
    - button "Create API key"
  - region "Issued credentials":
    - text: Workspace keys
    - heading "Issued credentials" [level=2]
    - paragraph: No API keys yet. Create one for automation with explicit scopes.

- main "Skills":
  - region "Skills and version history":
    - text: User-authored Skills
    - heading "Skills and version history" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Publish reusable workflow instructions for your team. Each publish creates an immutable version; edits always create a new version and never mutate a published snapshot. Skills cannot access database, storage, or billing credentials.
    - button "Publish Skill"
  - region "Published Skills":
    - text: Workspace Skills
    - heading "Published Skills" [level=2]
    - paragraph: No Skills yet. Publish your first reusable workflow instruction.
  - region "Version history":
    - text: Immutable versions
    - heading "Version history" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Select a Skill to inspect its immutable published versions.
